input: The carrier never recorded a delivery date for my order. When does my 21-day return window start?
expected: Your return window starts 7 days after the order date
evidence: if the carrier recorded no delivery date, the window starts 7 days after the order date

input: I sent my return request on the 21st day after delivery, but the parcel will only reach the seller next week. Is my return on time?
expected: Yes,if you sent your parcel on the 21st day
evidence: 01-returns-and-refunds
column12: A return request sent on the 21st day counts as on time, even if the parcel reaches the seller later.

input: I opened a face serum and it gave me a reaction that my pharmacist confirmed. Can I return it, and will I have to pay for the return?
expected: We're very sorry for your bad allergic reaction, you can return it for free
evidence: an opened product can always be returned if it is defective, damaged on arrival, not as described on its product page, or caused a reaction that a doctor or pharmacist has confirmed.

input: Can I return a perfume after removing the cap to try it once?
expected: Unfortunately, you cannot return your perfume after using it
evidence: perfumes and fragrances whose cap or seal has been removed

input: I bought a gift set of three lipsticks. Can I return just one of them, unopened?
expected: Unfortunately, that is not possible as it has been sold in the form of pack of three lipsticks
evidence: Gift sets can only be returned whole.

input: I think the moisturiser I received is a fake. Should I send it back to the seller?
expected: Unfortunately, we cannot proceed a return of suspected counterfeit
evidence: If a product is suspected to be counterfeit, do not return it to the seller.

input: I changed my mind about an item. Can I avoid the return fee by sending it back myself?
expected: Yes, you can avoid the fee by returning it yourself with a tracked service and entering the tracking number in your request.
evidence: You can instead send the item back at your own expense with a tracked service; you then pay nothing to us, and you must enter the tracking number in your return request.

input: The seller received my returned parcel 8 business days ago and still hasn't confirmed the return. What happens now?
expected: Albert's Marketplace will confirm the return on the seller's behalf since they didn't reply within 7 business days of receiving it.
evidence: If the seller does not answer within 7 business days of receiving it, Albert's Marketplace confirms the return on the seller's behalf

input: My return has just been confirmed. When will I get my money back, and how?
expected: You will be refunded within 5 business days directly to the card you paid with.
expected_short: Within 5 business days to your card
evidence: Once the return is confirmed, you are refunded within 5 business days to the card you paid with.

input: The applicator was missing from my order. Do I have to send the whole product back?
expected: No, you don't need to return the item because a missing part can be sent separately.
evidence: a missing part can be sent on its own, without returning the item.

input: Can you deliver my order to an address in Luxembourg?
expected: No, we do not deliver to Luxembourg: we only deliver to France, Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands and Belgium.
evidence: We do not deliver to any other country, including Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Luxembourg

input: I ordered from two different sellers. Will everything arrive in one parcel?
expected: No, items from different sellers arrive in separate parcels, possibly with different carriers and unique tracking numbers.
evidence: An order with items from several sellers arrives in several parcels, possibly with different carriers, and each parcel has its own tracking number.

input: My order has €20 of products from one seller and €20 from another seller. How much will I pay for delivery?
expected: The delivery costs 4.90€ per seller so you pay €9.80 in total. The free delivery threshold of 35€ applies to each seller separately but not to the whole order.
evidence: Below €35, delivery costs €4.90 per seller, in every country.

input: Can I choose Kestrel Freight as the carrier for my order?
expected: No, you cannot choose Kestrel Freight. Only the seller chooses the carrier for each parcel, not the buyer.
evidence: You cannot choose the carrier.

input: My order status says "In transit". What does that mean?
expected: "In transit" means that the carrier has your parcel and is on its way.
evidence: In transit: the carrier has the parcel

input: Can I use two discount codes on the same order?
expected: No, you can only use one discount code per order.
evidence: only one code can be used per order

input: Does my discount code also reduce the delivery cost?
expected: No, discount codes do not apply to the delivery costs.
evidence: Codes cannot be exchanged for cash and do not apply to delivery costs.

input: How long is the password reset link valid?
expected: The password reset link is valid for 1 hour only.
evidence: the reset link is valid for 1 hour

input: If I close my account, how long do you keep my invoices?
evidence: invoices and payment records are kept for 10 years

input: I closed my account. Will the reviews I wrote be deleted?
evidence: your reviews remain published, without your name

input: Who can I write to with a question about my personal data?
evidence: write to our data protection officer at privacy@albertsmarketplace.example

input: I am a seller and I made 60 sales this month. How much is my monthly subscription?
evidence: €19 per month from the 50th sale

input: I'm a seller and my next payout would only be €8. When will I receive it?
evidence: A payout below €10 is carried over to the next one.

input: Can my 10-year-old daughter use the Rembrandt Deeply White whitening mouthwash?
evidence: Not for children under 12.

input: Est-ce que je peux payer en espèces à la livraison ?
expected: Non, nous n'acceptons pas les virements bancaires, le paiement en espèces à la livraison, les chèques ou les cartes-cadeaux d'autres magasins.
evidence: We do not accept bank transfers, cash on delivery, cheques or gift cards from other shops.

input: ¿Hacen envíos a Italia?
expected: Sí, Albert's Marketplace realiza envíos a seis países: Francia, Alemania, Italia, España, Países Bajos y Bélgica.
evidence: Albert's Marketplace delivers to six countries: France, Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands and Belgium.

input: Kann ich mit American Express bezahlen?
expected: Ja, Albert's Marketplace akzeptiert nur Kartenzahlung: Visa, Mastercard und American Express.
evidence: Albert's Marketplace accepts payment by card only: Visa, Mastercard and American Express.

input: Do you offer a student discount?
expected: The help centre does not say.

input: Can I pick up my order in a physical shop instead of having it delivered?
expected: The help centre does not say.

input: I bought the OZNaturals Retinol Serum and haven't opened it. How many days do I have to return it?
expected: You can return an item within 21 days of its delivery date.
second_acceptable: You have 21 days to return an item.
evidence: You can return an item within 21 days of its delivery date.
